annotations.title: How many sgRNAs fit in one non-repetitive array

description: Report how many promoters, sgRNA handles and neutral spacers are available at each maximum-shared-length threshold, and therefore the longest extra-long sgRNA array that can be built without reusing a part. Ask this before designing: the answer is a property of the measured parts collection, not of your guides, and it is the constraint that decides the design. Deterministic — it is a selection over a fixed table.

lmax.description: Report a single threshold. Omit to get the whole curve from 8 to 24.
